Members.Name: GetVREyeMask
Members.Description: Gets the hidden triangle mesh for eye 0 or 1 on the render thread. Counts are vertex and index capacities on input and required counts on output. Null buffers query counts; xy has two floats per vertex, indices are a UINT32 triangle list. Winding is counter-clockwise in x-right, y-up coordinates. Vertices are view-angle tangents at z=+1. Map to your projection with ndc.x = (2*x - (tan(AngleRight) + tan(AngleLeft))) / (tan(AngleRight) - tan(AngleLeft)); use up/down in the same way for y.
Members.ReturnDescription: S_OK; S_FALSE for an empty mesh; E_NOTIMPL without mask support; E_INVALIDARG for invalid index, null counts or insufficient buffer capacity (required counts are still returned); E_ILLEGAL_METHOD_CALL without a session or on the wrong thread; E_FAIL on runtime failure. Counts are zero on error except for insufficient capacity

Args.Name: index
Args.Description: The eye, 0 or 1

Args.Name: vertexCount
Args.Description: The xy vertex capacity on input; the required vertex count on output

Args.Name: xy
Args.Description: Receives two floats per vertex, or null to query the counts

Args.Name: indexCount
Args.Description: The indices capacity on input; the required index count on output

Args.Name: indices
Args.Description: Receives a UINT32 triangle list, or null to query the counts

For reverse-Z pass the distant plane as nearZ and the close plane as farZ. Positive infinity is allowed for either plane, but the two must differ.
Members.ReturnDescription: S_OK; E_NOTIMPL without depth support; E_INVALIDARG for an invalid index or range; E_ILLEGAL_METHOD_CALL without a session, outside an eye frame or on the wrong thread; E_FAIL on runtime failure

Args.Name: index
Args.Description: The eye, 0 or 1

Args.Description: The distance in metres at depth value 0

Args.Name: farZ
Args.Description: The distance in metres at depth value 1

Color is premultiplied alpha.
Members.ReturnDescription: S_OK; E_NOTIMPL if the runtime cannot show a panel; E_INVALIDARG for an invalid size, space or pose; E_ILLEGAL_METHOD_CALL without a session or on the wrong thread; E_FAIL on runtime failure. Deferred creation errors are reported by GetVRPanelTarget

Textures rotate until RTBeforeBackBufferChange; descriptors can be kept by resource until then
Members.ReturnDescription: S_OK; E_INVALIDARG for an invalid index or null output; E_ILLEGAL_METHOD_CALL without a session, outside an eye frame or on the wrong thread; E_FAIL after a runtime failure. The output is null on error
